_doc: Retailer layout profiles — DATA, not code. Lookup order for a leaflet:
Fields: zoom (OCR render scale), price_position ('above'|'below' the model
code), notes (what 'correct' looks like), validated (audit trail: which
country+week+file this profile was last verified against).
Layouts CAN change week-over-week — every run writes a health record to
output/layout_health.jsonl and warns when the page stops matching the
profile. When that happens: audit the page, update this file, add a

Carrefour.notes: Price cluster at tile TOP (promo + struck 'D'-glyph RRP + -NN% badge), image middle, spec line + code at bottom. %-badge cross-check active.

Lulu.notes: Spec bullets at TOP, image, tabby/EMI financing line, struck was-price, red promo, name + code at bottom. No % badges (2-price pairs). Financing filtered via tabby/EMI markers.

SharafDG.notes: Dense 2-col grid. THREE prices: struck WAS / bold NOW / black 'DG member' chip (member -> Other Offer Details). Capacity chips (number over LITRES). NOW garbles below 4x zoom; garble-rescue active.

Emax.notes: Dark 3-col grid; brand/name/code at TOP, 'NET-607L' chip under code, image, prices at tile BOTTOM: glued 'WAS8999' + 'D8499' or 'D5499D5199' (now + card price). 'WORTH' freebie banners excluded.
